fixedRules: Once a recovery swap is accepted it must finish automatically exactly as accepted; register or verify replacement before old revocation.
Root exact write retry returns original response, while status GET may show progress.
Fitz broker snapshot fingerprint/watermark continuation is restricted to global selectors. StreamReadCursor fingerprint is bound to request position/selector.
ReviseApplication has JsonIgnore presence helpers; omitted and supplied-null have distinct semantics.

Tenant manager availability requires registered unsuspended member plus same-episode built-in Administrator team assignment; required role/perms are undeletable. Restoration must not clear other reasons.

counterexamples.recovery: Both proofs verified; root emits IdentityRecoveryAccepted; before identity protection, a competing registration binds replacement to another account. Accepted swap cannot finish.
counterexamples.canonical: Classification=null with IsSupplied=false means keep, but Classification=null with IsSupplied=true means clear. Serializing raw public command omits JsonIgnore flags so the hashes collide.
counterexamples.snapshot: Passing capturedWatermark/fingerprint on a realm selector hits ERR_CURSOR_UNSUPPORTED in sink/reads.rs; source SDK exposes parameters without this selector restriction in method signature.
counterexamples.reply: First PUT gives 202 Accepted, a later retry returns completed 200. That is progress, but it is not the original response.

recovery_acceptance_point.instructions: Which recovery acceptance point satisfies automatic exact-swap completion without silently accepting a conflicting account association?

criteria.prepare_protect_accept: Freeze both-proof-verified preparation keyed by challenge; protect old/replacement association slots; then append accepted swap; any conflict before acceptance rejects preparation safely. Accepted swap always recovers forward.
criteria.accept_then_protect: Append accepted swap first, then attempt replacement association protection; report conflict if another account won.
criteria.revoke_first: Revoke old identity before replacement registration.

canonical_presence.instructions: Which retry intent representation preserves current keep/clear semantics across HTTP/MCP/queue?

criteria.canonical_presence_dto: Dedicated immutable canonical input includes explicit presence Boolean plus normalized values; adapters and queues reconstruct identical flags.
criteria.serialize_public_command: Hash only the public DTO serializer output, letting JsonIgnore omit flags.
criteria.collapse_omit_null: Treat omission and null as equal even though current code distinguishes them.

snapshot_adapter.instructions: Which design uses the supplied broker capability honestly for coherent publication reads?

criteria.global_cut_selector_tokens: Capture exclusive global watermark; use global area/resource selectors with their own cursor fingerprints/snapshots and filter to original global cut plus exact realm. Never pass global continuation to realm selector.
criteria.realm_cursor_forward: Pass capturedWatermark/fingerprint to realm selector because SDK method parameters accept it.
criteria.per_row_refresh: Refresh publication status independently for every returned row.

write_response.instructions: Which public contract preserves an exact original asynchronous write response?

criteria.fixed_ack_status_query: All async writes return immutable 202 acknowledgment on first call and exact retries; GET status/result reports progress and final result.
criteria.retry_returns_current: Return whatever the resource currently looks like on each write retry.
criteria.retry_new_accepted_time: Return same operation ID but create a new accepted timestamp each retry.
